Performers
Advent Chamber Orchestra (ensemble), Roxana Pavel Goldstein (violin), Constance Schoepflin (flute), Matthew Ganong (harpsichord) Documented

The Commons Description and upstream programme agree on the ensemble and all three soloists. No conductor is credited.

[1] [2]
Work version
Unknown Unknown

The performing edition and continuo realisation are not identified. The 1871 Bach-⁠Gesellschaft score is used for commentary, not attributed to the performers.

[1] [2]
Recorded
February 2008 Documented

The upstream programme lists 10 and 17 February 2008. Neither source assigns this track to one concert day; the month is retained rather than guessing a day.

[1] [2]
Place
Unknown Unknown

The consulted file page and programme do not identify a recording venue; the ensemble’s home location is not a session location.

[1] [2]
Label
Unknown Unknown

Pandora/ibiblio and the Al Goldstein collection are the digital repository and collection, not an established original record label.

[1] [2]
Catalogue
Unknown Unknown

No original carrier catalogue number is supplied.

[1] [2]
Matrix, take, sides
Unknown Unknown

No matrix, take, side or original session-medium identification is supplied; the digital file alone does not establish that such identifiers are inapplicable.

[1] [2]
Transfer
Unknown Unknown

Al Goldstein is credited as collection source, not explicitly as recording or mastering engineer. The Commons uploader is not treated as transfer engineer.

[1]
Transfer date
Unknown Unknown

The November 2008 Commons upload date is not a transfer or session date.

[1]
Processing
Ogg Vorbis source; MP3 access derivative supplied by Wikimedia Commons. Documented

Embedded metadata names Xiph.Org libVorbis I 20020717. Original capture medium, editing and mastering are not documented; no no-edit claim is made.

[1]
Composition rights
Underlying composition is public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms. Inferred, not documented

Bach died in 1750; this does not clear an unidentified modern edition.

[4]
Recording rights
Rule 1 — sound-recording licence: Creative Commons Attribution-⁠ShareAlike 2.0 Generic. Documented

The file’s Permission and Licensing sections explicitly cover this performance, tracing it to Pandora’s Open Audio License. This is not a composition-only copyright tag.

[1]

Johann Sebastian Bach, Brandenburg Concerto No. 5, III. Allegro; Advent Chamber Orchestra, Roxana Pavel Goldstein, Constance Schoepflin and Matthew Ganong, February 2008. Al Goldstein collection / Pandora Music, ibiblio; Wikimedia Commons. CC BY-SA 2.0. Streamed without editorial audio edits. Rights statement
